title: Kita Mean wins Down Under Season 1
summary: In the Grand Finale (DU-S01-E08), Art Simone, Karen from Finance, Kita Mean, and Scarlet Adams lip-synced to Olivia Newton-John's "Physical". Kita Mean was crowned Down Under's first Drag Superstar and received A$30,000.

title: Jojo Zaho: Down Under's first Porkchop
summary: Jojo Zaho was the first contestant eliminated on RuPaul's Drag Race Down Under (DU-S01-E01), lip-syncing to the Bee Gees' "Tragedy" against Elektra Shock.

title: Art Simone returns after elimination
summary: Art Simone was eliminated in DU-S01-E02 after lip-syncing to RuPaul's "I'm That Bitch" against Coco Jumbo, then returned to the competition in DU-S01-E04 and went on to finish as a runner-up.
